description: Updates ONE subnet: rename it (`name`) and/or set attributes from the serve's allow-list for its net type (Ethernet: DefaultSubnet; Mpi: HighestAddress, TransmissionSpeed; Profibus: HighestAddress, TransmissionSpeed, BusProfile; tia_subnet_get lists `updatable` for the subnet; SubnetId is never updatable). Only the fields that differ from the current value are written (none passed: 400 missing_param; all unchanged: 200 with changes:[]). A rename takes at most 24 characters: a longer name is 400 invalid_subnet_name (details.name, length, maxLength), a dryRun included, after the subnet is found and before its attribute list is read or anything is written, although tia_subnet_create accepts longer names; a name equal to the subnet's current name is not a rename and is not refused, and the serve counts UTF-16 code units as sent, spaces included. Refused, nothing changed: 409 subnet_name_in_use (details.existing) when another subnet has the name, ignoring case; 400 unsupported_subnet_attribute (details.unsupported, details.allowed); 409 subnet_not_writable (details.attributes); 409 subnet_attribute_unreadable (details.attributes: the current value could not be read, so a failed write could not be rolled back); 409 subnet_attribute_list_unavailable (details.attributes, details.reason: the attribute list of the subnet could not be read, so it cannot be verified that they can be written); 400 bad_request for a blank name; 404 not_found for an unknown subnet. The result carries `changes` [{field,from,to}] and a `postcheck` (the serve re-reads the subnet after the write); a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches; details.rollback says whether the previous values were restored, verified by a fresh read; details.restoreFailures lists every field that is NOT back at its previous value): re-read with tia_subnet_get before anything else. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs the same guards and returns the plan WITHOUT changing anything. Maps to POST /subnets/{subnet}. M-off.

attributes.description: name→value map of the subnet attributes to set (only the allow-listed ones of its net type, e.g., { DefaultSubnet: true })

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

subnet.description: current subnet name, as listed by tia_subnets

name: tia_subnet_update
title: TIA — update subnet
